system.description: Fire gives birth to smoke. Smoke gives birth to hazards. When you cast a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword that requires an attack, you can, once per turn, cause your flames to instead be overcome with a gout of black and gray smoke. All creatures within 5 feet of the original target(s), must make a Dexterity saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Dazzled. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at 15th.
